deterministicScope: The Ultimate DOOM IWAD (DOOM.WAD, retail, 36 maps / 4 episodes) is proprietary and never bundled — the C1 product target is shareware (PRIMARY_TARGET.gameMode shareware, DOOM1.WAD). The Ultimate parity smoke is intrinsically conditional: it runs `bun run doom.ts -iwad iwad/DOOM.WAD` ONLY when the user supplies an Ultimate iwad/DOOM.WAD, and is correctly skipped (not failed) when absent. This gate proves that conditional behaviour deterministically: scope contract, correct presence detection, the shareware copy is not misclassified as Ultimate, and the Ultimate smoke is presence-gated.
